draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.81, the 205th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 17th of 25 at LB. He went 146th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (205th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing standouts: 20-yard shuttle (87th percentile), three-cone (85th percentile). College production: 77 tackles in 2021, 16th of 25 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the New York Giants. 48 career games and 36 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 3 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2025 against a career-best 8 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (0th percentile). Played 1 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-4 off-ball linebacker who played: 3 combined tackles against a median of 40, below the norm.
